backup.production_rule: One new table public.concierge_turn_stats (RLS on, no policy, service_role select/insert only) and one new function public.cassy_week_v1(timestamptz) (security definer, service_role execute only). No existing data, function or grant changes. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: service_role_only_table
forward_verification.query: select c.relrowsecurity and not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'concierge_turn_stats') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.concierge_turn_stats','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.concierge_turn_stats','select') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.concierge_turn_stats','insert') from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.concierge_turn_stats'::regclass

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260929_concierge_turn_stats.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (drops cassy_week_v1 and concierge_turn_stats; the stats rows are lost). No function redeploy needed: the messenger-concierge insert and the daily-digest read are advisory.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply, then deploy messenger-concierge and daily-digest from waves 8861b82 or later. Deploying first is safe: the insert logs turn_stats_failed and the Monday card goes out without the Cassy lines.
